backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining stories, comments, reviews, user profiles, and access‑controlled operations for submitting stories and interacting with discussions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing pre-generated 1–2 sentence summaries for multiple frontend source files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Documentation describing deployment steps, canister roles, and troubleshooting guidance for the Internet Computer setup.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and theming definitions for light and dark modes with OKLCH-based color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app and mounting it into the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration defining routes for all primary pages and wrapping content with the shared layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing an access-denied message with a link back to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component showing the site brand and navigation buttons for Home and About only.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Overall layout wrapper with header, footer, and global navigation links including About and Troubleshooting.
Comment form component allowing users to submit comments with a name and message, integrating with mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays comments for a story using useGetComments, with loading skeletons and formatted timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows comments for a story from aggregated discussions, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Renders canister diagnostic info with copy buttons to assist troubleshooting deployment issues.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Provides a form to submit a review with rating, handle, and optional comment via useAddReview.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays reviews for a story from discussions, showing ratings, timestamps, and optional comments.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all stories and publish reworded stories using admin actor methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend heartbeat availability when enabled and returns reachability state.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Fetches all discussions and provides a mutation to add reviews, auto‑refreshing discussion data.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using Dfinity AuthClient, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Implements React Query hooks for fetching stories and comments and submitting new stories or comments via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes, including typography and UI states.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page describing the author and providing contact information in a styled card layout.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Provides an admin interface for reviewing and publishing submitted stories, with moderation actions and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays discussions grouped by story title with tabs for comments and reviews, allowing topic selection and thread viewing.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the published stories feed, handles loading and backend availability errors, and shows troubleshooting guidance when fetching fails.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero content and feature cards, directing users to read or submit stories.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Loads and displays a single story with metadata and comments, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Form page for submitting a new story with optional anonymity and success confirmation flow.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Provides diagnostic info and instructions when canister IDs cannot be resolved, including copyable URLs and error explanations.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Utility for detecting frontend and backend canister IDs from hostname or env vars and generating standard and raw URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or session state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state and pending requests related to updating navigation and moving reviews/comments into a new section.
